iPhone fixes: 16 px fields so Safari does not zoom, no sideways scrolling, route cards fit.
Route-wind bug sweep (wind applied on Calculate, wind triangle, TAS followed, stale-results note). This is the 'ferry backup': fewest moving parts.
Adds planning date, Local/UTC switch, ATS and fuel opening hours and automated NOTAM checks (FAA source, blocked from GitHub).
Manual NOTAM check with a copy-route button for IPPC; opening-hours check date and stale warning.

Page as it stood in the local clone before the forecast-wind build (label v6). 518 bytes larger than the 240196-byte v6 logged on 2026-09-30, so it was edited after that entry. Revert point: copy this file over ferry.html.

Forecast wind: per-leg GS | Wind | Forecast, Open-Meteo ICON pressure-level winds sampled every 20 NM, time-marched wind-triangle integration, cruise altitude slider 1,000-10,000 ft (single or per leg), async Calculate, impossible-wind refusal in Wind mode, version label with build date.

Coastwise routing: two independent switches (Vestlandet: SUMAK-UPLOR-VEMAM-ADNUM, Helgeland: SUKAM-ADRIP). Airports are projected onto the coastal chain and each leg uses only the waypoints between its two airports, in travel order. Distance, wind (per segment track), forecast integration, ETE, fuel, map and Optimize Route all use the routed path. A coastal path more than 35% longer than direct is not used. Both switches OFF: identical to v7. Revert point: versions/ferry.v7.html.
Earliest kept: three tabs (dashboard, next 14 nights, moon calendar), Local/UTC, iPhone no-zoom fix. Earlier iterations were not kept.
Adds green/amber/red mlx colours and the moon-distance fix.
Night rows labelled by the whole night, tap opens at the brightest moment, list keeps its start.
Graph in the app's 402 × 140 proportions on phones (capped at 170 px tall on wide screens); the page shows its own version number in the footer.
Version label made discreet (small 'v5' at the bottom instead of a footer sentence).
